title: Accounting
tagline: Master financial accounting principles and practices.
description: Every business runs on its books. This program builds real bookkeeping and financial-statement skills — from double-entry fundamentals to preparing a full set of financial statements in Tally and Excel — the practical skills accounting and finance roles actually use day to day.
outcomes: Record and reconcile day-to-day business transactions
Prepare financial statements: P&L, balance sheet, cash flow
Work confidently with Tally and Excel for accounting
Understand basic statutory compliance for a small business

topics: Maintain full books for a sample business for a month

projects: Maintain a full set of books in Tally for a sample business
Prepare a complete set of financial statements

faqs.q: Do I need a commerce background?
faqs.a: No — the program starts from double-entry fundamentals, no prior accounting study required.

faqs.q: Will I actually use Tally, or just watch demos?
faqs.a: You'll maintain a full month of books yourself in Tally as part of the capstone project.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Live and Self-Paced?
faqs.a: Live batches include instructor-led sessions, real-time doubt clearing, and mentorship. Self-Paced gives you the recorded content on your own schedule. Both include the same projects and certificate.
